name: ChatGPT
desc: OpenAI's conversational assistant for answering questions, drafting text, analyzing files, generating images and browsing the web in one chat interface.

name: Claude
desc: Anthropic's AI assistant for long-form writing, document analysis, coding help and reasoning through complex questions across text and uploaded files.

name: Gemini
desc: Google's multimodal assistant that answers questions, works with images and documents, and connects to Gmail, Docs and other Google apps.

name: Microsoft Copilot
desc: Microsoft's consumer AI companion for chatting, web-grounded answers, image creation and everyday help across Windows, Edge and mobile apps.

name: Meta AI
desc: Meta's assistant built on Llama models, available on the web and inside WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Facebook for chat and images.

name: Le Chat
desc: Mistral AI's chat assistant offering fast responses, web search, document upload and image generation powered by the company's own language models.

name: Grok
desc: xAI's conversational assistant with real-time access to posts on X, web search, image generation and a reasoning mode for harder problems.

name: Grammarly
desc: Writing assistant that checks grammar, spelling, clarity and tone, and offers generative rewrites inside browsers, email clients and desktop apps.

name: Jasper
desc: Content platform for marketing teams that generates on-brand copy, campaigns and blog posts using stored brand voice and style guidelines.

name: Copy.ai
desc: Generates sales and marketing copy and lets teams build repeatable go-to-market workflows for emails, prospecting and content production.

name: QuillBot
desc: Paraphrasing tool with grammar checking, summarizing, citation generation and translation, widely used by students and writers to rework text.

name: Wordtune
desc: Suggests alternative phrasings for sentences, adjusts tone and length, and summarizes long articles or documents directly in the browser.

name: Sudowrite
desc: Fiction-focused writing tool that helps novelists brainstorm, expand scenes, describe settings and draft chapters while keeping their story bible consistent.

name: Midjourney
desc: Text-to-image generator known for stylized, high-detail artwork, with a web editor for variations, upscaling, inpainting and style references.

name: Adobe Firefly
desc: Adobe's generative image and video models for creating and editing visuals, integrated with Photoshop, Illustrator, Express and other Creative Cloud apps.

name: Leonardo.Ai
desc: Image generation platform with fine-tuned models, a real-time canvas and asset tools aimed at game art, concept design and marketing visuals.

name: Ideogram
desc: Image generator recognized for rendering legible text inside pictures, useful for posters, logos, social graphics and typographic designs.

name: Recraft
desc: Generates and edits raster and vector images, icons and illustrations with consistent brand styles, exporting editable SVG files for designers.

name: ComfyUI
desc: Node-based interface for building and running image and video generation pipelines locally with Stable Diffusion, Flux and other open models.

name: Runway
desc: Creative suite for generating video from text or images, plus AI editing tools for motion tracking, background removal and visual effects.

name: Pika
desc: Turns text prompts and images into short video clips, with effects for transforming, swapping and animating objects within a scene.

name: Synthesia
desc: Produces presenter-style videos from scripts using AI avatars and voices in many languages, commonly used for training and corporate communication.

name: HeyGen
desc: Creates talking-avatar videos from text, clones a user's likeness and voice, and translates existing videos with lip-synced dubbing.

name: Luma Dream Machine
desc: Luma AI's video and image generator that creates realistic camera motion and scenes from text prompts, reference images or keyframes.

name: Kling AI
desc: Kuaishou's video generation model that produces clips from text or images with realistic motion, plus lip-sync and image tools.

name: Descript
desc: Edits video and podcasts by editing the transcript, with filler-word removal, studio sound, screen recording and AI voice regeneration.

name: ElevenLabs
desc: Generates natural-sounding speech in many languages, clones voices, dubs video and powers conversational voice agents through an app and API.

name: Suno
desc: Creates complete songs with vocals and instrumentation from a text prompt or user-written lyrics, with tools for extending and editing tracks.

name: Murf
desc: Text-to-speech studio offering a library of voices for voiceovers, with controls for pitch, pacing and emphasis plus video syncing.

name: Adobe Podcast
desc: Browser-based recording and editing tool whose Enhance Speech feature cleans noise and echo so voice recordings sound studio-quality.

name: Whisper
desc: OpenAI's open speech recognition model that transcribes and translates audio across dozens of languages and can run on local hardware.

name: Speechify
desc: Reads documents, web pages, PDFs and emails aloud with adjustable speed and natural voices across browser, desktop and mobile apps.

name: GitHub Copilot
desc: Code completion and chat assistant inside VS Code, JetBrains and GitHub, with an agent that can implement issues and open pull requests.

name: Cursor
desc: AI-first code editor built on VS Code that understands an entire codebase, edits across multiple files and runs agentic coding tasks.

name: Claude Code
desc: Anthropic's agentic coding tool that works in the terminal, IDE or web to read codebases, edit files, run commands and handle git.

name: Windsurf
desc: Agentic IDE whose Cascade assistant plans and carries out multi-step coding changes, alongside fast autocomplete and in-editor previews.

name: Replit
desc: Browser-based development environment where an AI agent builds, runs and deploys full applications from natural-language descriptions.

name: Aider
desc: Command-line pair-programming tool that edits code in a local git repository using GPT, Claude or local models and commits changes automatically.

name: Lovable
desc: Generates full-stack web applications from chat prompts, with a visual editor, Supabase integration, GitHub sync and one-click publishing.

name: Notion AI
desc: Built into Notion workspaces to search across connected tools, draft and summarize pages, transcribe meetings and autofill database properties.

name: Otter.ai
desc: Joins meetings on Zoom, Teams and Google Meet to record, transcribe and summarize conversations with searchable notes and action items.

name: Fireflies.ai
desc: Meeting assistant that records and transcribes calls, produces summaries, and lets teams search and analyze conversations across platforms.

name: Motion
desc: Plans each workday automatically by scheduling tasks, projects and meetings on the calendar and reshuffling them when priorities change.

name: Granola
desc: Meeting notepad that captures computer audio without a bot and combines the transcript with your own jotted notes into clean summaries.

name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
desc: Assistant embedded in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams that drafts, summarizes and analyzes content using organizational data.

name: Perplexity
desc: Answer engine that searches the web in real time and returns cited, conversational answers, with deeper multi-step research reports on demand.

name: Elicit
desc: Research assistant that finds academic papers, extracts data from them into tables and helps automate parts of systematic literature reviews.

name: Consensus
desc: Search engine that answers questions using peer-reviewed research, summarizing findings and showing how studies agree or disagree on a topic.

name: NotebookLM
desc: Google's research notebook that answers questions grounded in your uploaded sources and can turn them into audio overviews and study guides.

name: Semantic Scholar
desc: Free scholarly search engine from the Allen Institute for AI that uses machine learning to surface relevant papers and summarize them.

name: Scite
desc: Shows how scientific papers have been cited, classifying citations as supporting or contrasting, and answers questions with referenced sources.

name: Zapier
desc: Connects thousands of web apps to automate workflows, with AI steps, agents and chatbots that act on data moving between tools.

name: Make
desc: Visual automation platform for designing multi-step scenarios that move data between apps, including AI modules and agent-based workflows.

name: n8n
desc: Workflow automation tool with a node-based editor, self-hosting option and built-in AI agent nodes for connecting apps and language models.

name: IFTTT
desc: Links apps, smart-home devices and online services through simple trigger-and-action applets, including AI-powered steps for content and summaries.

name: UiPath
desc: Enterprise automation platform combining robotic process automation, document understanding and AI agents to run business processes across systems.

name: Lindy
desc: Lets users build AI agents that handle email triage, meeting scheduling, lead outreach and other repetitive tasks across connected apps.

name: Canva
desc: Online design platform for social graphics, presentations and documents, with AI tools for generating images, text and layout edits.

name: Figma
desc: Collaborative interface design tool with AI features for generating layouts, prototyping from prompts, renaming layers and searching design assets.

name: Gamma
desc: Generates presentations, documents and simple websites from a prompt or outline, with editable layouts, themes and AI image generation.

name: Framer
desc: Website builder for designers that generates pages from prompts, supports visual editing and animations, and publishes responsive sites with hosting.

name: Looka
desc: Generates logo options from a company name and style preferences, then builds matching brand kits, business cards and social assets.

name: Photoroom
desc: Photo editor that removes backgrounds and creates product shots with generated scenes, shadows and batch editing for e-commerce listings.

name: HubSpot
desc: CRM and marketing platform whose Breeze AI tools draft content, enrich contact records, score leads and run customer-facing agents.

name: Surfer
desc: SEO content tool that analyzes top-ranking pages and guides writers on keywords, structure and length to optimize articles for search.

name: Semrush
desc: Search marketing suite for keyword research, site audits, competitor analysis and tracking brand visibility in AI-generated search answers.

name: AdCreative.ai
desc: Generates ad banners, copy and product visuals sized for major ad networks and scores creatives for predicted performance before launch.

name: Buffer
desc: Social media scheduling tool with an AI assistant that drafts, repurposes and tailors posts for each network alongside analytics.

name: Clearscope
desc: Content optimization platform that grades drafts against search intent and recommends terms and topics to improve relevance and coverage.

name: Julius AI

name: Tableau
desc: Salesforce's visual analytics platform for building interactive dashboards, with AI features that explain trends and answer questions in plain language.

name: Power BI
desc: Microsoft's business intelligence service for modeling data and building reports, with Copilot assistance for writing queries and summarizing visuals.

name: Hex
desc: Collaborative data workspace combining SQL, Python and no-code cells, with AI that writes queries and lets business users ask questions.

name: ThoughtSpot
desc: Search-driven analytics platform where users type natural-language questions about company data and receive charts and AI-generated insights.

name: Deepnote
desc: Collaborative data notebook for Python and SQL with an AI agent that writes code, builds visualizations and turns analyses into apps.

name: OpenAI Platform
desc: API access to OpenAI's GPT, image, speech and embedding models, with tools for building agents, function calling and fine-tuning.

name: Claude Developer Platform

name: Google AI Studio

name: Hugging Face
desc: Hub hosting hundreds of thousands of open models, datasets and demo apps, plus libraries and inference services for machine learning developers.

name: Replicate
desc: Runs open-source and custom machine learning models through a cloud API, billing by compute time without managing GPUs or servers.

name: Ollama

name: LangChain

name: Khanmigo

name: Duolingo

name: Quizlet

name: Photomath

name: Speak
desc: Language-learning app focused on speaking practice, using an AI tutor that holds conversations and gives feedback on pronunciation and grammar.

name: MagicSchool
desc: Platform for teachers with tools to create lesson plans, rubrics, quizzes and feedback, plus supervised AI tools for students.

name: Wolfram|Alpha
desc: Computational knowledge engine that solves math, science and data questions with step-by-step solutions and plots, drawing on curated data.
